name: Kite
description: A delighted woman in her sixties who sings sixties folk-pop, a kite flyer permanently tangled in her own string and loving it.
build: A slim, small-framed older woman of ordinary proportions: narrow shoulders, a straight torso, slender arms and legs, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Fair lightly freckled skin with rosy cheeks, bright hazel eyes framed by laugh lines, arched silver-grey brows, a small upturned nose, and thin lips.
hair: A short curly silver-grey bob, full and wind-tousled, standing out around the head and clear of the eyes.
outfit: A roomy bright red zip-up windbreaker with wide bold white stripes down both sleeves, sleeves pushed to the forearms so both hands are fully bare; a teal-green high-necked cotton top under it; slim khaki-tan cropped trousers to mid-calf; white canvas sneakers with thick soles. Two loops of thick bright yellow kite string wrap loosely around her torso and her character-left forearm. Her head is bare.
performance_style: Light and upright: feet close together, weight on the balls of the feet. Both arms raised, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty at shoulder height, fingers visible, as if feeling the wind. Head tipped up slightly, a wide delighted smile.
location: A breezy grassy dune top above a wide beach: pale sand and marram grass running to the bottom of the frame, a low wooden snow fence behind, the sea glittering beyond, and a bright blue sky dotted with colourful diamond kites.
recognition_cues: a red windbreaker with wide bold white sleeve stripes
loops of thick yellow kite string wrapped around her
a short curly wind-tousled silver-grey bob
avoid: a kite held in the hands on the key art

sing.intent: Folk-pop vocal loop: sway gently from foot to foot, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, sweep the open character-left hand in a slow arc overhead like a kite on the wind, then return to the light upright stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a gust: the shoulders lift, both open hands grab at the air at chest height, then she settles back to the light stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: step the feet wider, cross both forearms loosely in front of the chest with the hands open, then hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: skip in backward-glancing as if following a kite, turn square to the front, and land in the light upright stance with both hands raised and open.
